title.text: The card of the till with stock

runs.text: Place each piece of data from the till with stock problem in its zone of the card.
The initial stock is a fixed value, like the prices; the final stock is an output, because it depends on what was sold during the day.
The code and the amount of each sale
The stock each product starts with
The lines of the receipt and the rejections
The total and the total with discount
The stock left of each product
